video_title: Iman Shumpert - OG Anunoby Deserves A Statue OVER Jalen Brunson

quotes.speaker: Iman Shumpert
quotes.summary_phrase: Iman Shumpert on players focusing on the actual game
quotes.excerpt: I love the fact that we as the players are all coming together on these media platforms
quotes.quote: I try to focus on basketball. Too many times we get caught in storylines, and that's all well and good, media is media, but I love the fact that we as the players are all coming together on these media platforms to discuss the actual game.

quotes.speaker: Iman Shumpert
quotes.summary_phrase: Iman Shumpert on the Knicks' championship focus
quotes.excerpt: they had a laser focus in that locker room that they were going to win a championship
quotes.quote: For the franchise, everybody that's gotten to put on a New York Knicks jersey, they all reap the benefits of having a celebration. To have everybody that wore that jersey be touched by the fans, tweeted by the fans, the comments were crazy, the energy was crazy. But when we really break down what happened, the Knicks won for them. Those guys, not having the history connected to them, they had a laser focus in that locker room that they were going to win a championship since day one. I feel like they now changed the DNA of the NBA. There is now a challenge that has to go to GMs to build an actual team.

quotes.speaker: Iman Shumpert
quotes.summary_phrase: Iman Shumpert on the importance of team building
quotes.excerpt: you're going to have to put together a team around that. You're going to have to go out
quotes.quote: We can never say the big three thing is gone because if you get the right three together, we understand the gravity and magnitude of what can be done. But when you start talking about things that happen throughout the playoffs, we already saw the best ability is availability. You have to be healthy, you have to be ready to play if you want to win in this league. Even when you put together your top three, you're going to have to put together a team around that. You're going to have to go out here and really do your homework and say, 'Hey, this guy was this version of himself in this team, and we're going to get him to buy in to be this version of himself on this here team.'

quotes.speaker: Iman Shumpert
quotes.summary_phrase: Iman Shumpert on the importance of veteran leadership
quotes.excerpt: it also left a window for veteran leadership to be talked about again
quotes.quote: It also left a window for veteran leadership to be talked about again, because all those guys had been through the playoffs, they all had playoff experience, they all had a heartbreak in the playoffs, and that was the one thing that San Antonio didn't have. So the landscape changed a little bit.

quotes.speaker: Iman Shumpert
quotes.summary_phrase: Iman Shumpert on the alumni lounge conversations
quotes.excerpt: I'm breaking down, you know, Wemby with John Starks, Stefan Marbury, Patrick Ewing, Patrick Ewing and Latrell Sprewell
quotes.quote: There's times that I could sit down, I'm having a Caesar salad, some balsamic vinaigrette, just to set the table for you, some sliced cheese and some crackers, and I'm breaking down, you know, Wemby with John Starks, Stefan Marbury, Stefan Marbury, Patrick Ewing, you know, Patrick Ewing and Latrell Sprewell. And we're sitting down and we're talking, and for a moment I have to like snap out of it like, 'I used to play with all y'all in the video game.'

quotes.speaker: Iman Shumpert
quotes.summary_phrase: Iman Shumpert on the greatest Knicks player debate
quotes.excerpt: it's between Jalen Brunson and Clyde Frazier just because they're winners
quotes.quote: I can't agree with him. I got to say it's between Jalen Brunson and Clyde Frazier just because they're winners. I'm, that's my opinion by the way, everybody's going to have their debates, but my opinion is winning matters. I didn't start playing basketball for nothing else but winning. If I was in my career for anything other than winning, I probably would have played for longer, I wouldn't have won shit, but I'd have played for longer and probably got to be around and do more things just for my name. But the approach that I had was all about winning, and when you do that, sometimes you got to sacrifice a little bit of yourself.

quotes.speaker: Iman Shumpert
quotes.summary_phrase: Iman Shumpert on OG Anunoby's statue
quotes.quote: The statue is OG Anunoby. I think that's the statue. I can't imagine

quotes.speaker: Iman Shumpert
quotes.summary_phrase: Iman Shumpert on Victor Wembanyama's villain arc
quotes.excerpt: you got to be good enough for me to hate you
quotes.quote: First of all, we have to realize that you got to be good enough for me to hate you. You got to be good enough. You know how many players in this league that people don't like, but they don't care? We ain't got time to wake up and hate on you and get mad at you. We ain't got time. With so many other players to talk about and deal with on a day-to-day, we do not have to worry. You got to worry about Victor Wembanyama. He was messing up people's sleep. This is perfect. This is what the NBA does. I just like it because this showed Victor Wembanyama, because he was like the nicest alien in the world, wasn't he? But then we got reminded in the playoffs, 'Oh, the aliens might come down and just snatch us up and never bring us home.' That's what aliens do.

quotes.speaker: Iman Shumpert
quotes.summary_phrase: Iman Shumpert on Victor Wembanyama's playing style
quotes.excerpt: he's a mean fighting machine and I like it though
quotes.quote: He's also like, you know how the British actors come and take the American jobs? It's like, once the movie over, y'all do know he still got the accent. He just sounds nice. He's not nice. He just sounds, he be like, 'Yes, you know, I like to do that and, you know.' But it's like that's how he sound, but he got the American accent on the court. He a mean, he a mean fighting machine and I like it though. I do love that he battles because he is going to run into a lot of battles in the NBA because he's so tall, because he's so talented. In totality, he's going to have to deal with the most abuse because it's one, not going to look like he getting beat up, but he's going to have to take punishment. And if he can take the punishment, he should be able to dish some out.
